definitions: to invent a story, excuse, or explanation
to reconcile after a quarrel or disagreement
to form or constitute a whole
to apply cosmetics to the face
to compensate for something lost or missed
examples: He had to make up an excuse for being late.
They had a fight but quickly decided to make up.
Women make up fifty percent of the workforce.
She needs time to make up her face before the show.
I will make up the hours I missed tomorrow.
